segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin generally report the oil absorbs quickly and does not add greasiness or worsen oiliness, with several calling it their go-to despite initial skepticism.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including seasonal and extreme dryness, consistently report significant hydration, smoother skin, and relief from peeling or itching.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it balances moisture without triggering excess oil, and some note it helps with barrier support in winter.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with eczema, PCOS-related sensitivity, or perioral dermatitis, report no breakouts or irritation and often describe soothing effects.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her late 30s/40s and one turning 67 report it moisturizes effectively without heaviness and helps with dryness associated with aging skin.
segments.normal: A reviewer describing normal-to-combination skin found it insufficient alone as a moisturizer, needing to layer another product on top.

concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers using the product in their late 30s to late 60s report it moisturizes well without feeling heavy, with one noting smoother fine lines and diminished dark spots; effects on aging specifically are otherwise not detailed.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, across skin types, report strong relief from dryness, peeling, itching, and winter dehydration; one reviewer with dry skin found it too heavy and greasy for her preference.
concerns.redness: Reviewers mention using it to calm irritation and redness from other products or from dermaplaning, with no reports of the oil itself causing redness.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers credit the oil with protecting or restoring the skin barrier, especially in cold/dry conditions or alongside retinoids/tretinoin, describing it as key to preventing dryness-related damage.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports reduced dark spots and another notes it healed eczema and perioral dermatitis patches; these are isolated reports rather than a consistent pattern.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone or blemish-prone skin report no new breakouts and some describe fewer pimples or extracted plugs/blackheads; one reviewer explicitly states it caused breakouts despite rarely breaking out.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin largely report it does not increase oiliness and even helps regulate excess oil, though a few describe a heavy or greasy feel, particularly right after application.

BOTTOM LINE: Great results, unbeatable price, and unparalleled ingredient transparency and consideration. In my opinion, you simply cannot go wrong with this or any other Good Molecules products. Hormonal acne prone, sensitive skin approved. I have PCOS, so my skin is incredibly sensitive while also being extremely prone to hormonal/cystic acne. I was skeptical at first since I've never tried any facial oil and was worried it might cause acne, but I love my other Good Molecules products and really needed something to provide more moisture for my face than traditional facial lotions alone. This does the trick! I've noticed it doesn't layer over certain serums as well as I had hoped, causing a bit of pilling, but to be honest, this product works well enough that I don't really need to put any serums before it at all anyways. I am able to layer facial lotions over it without any issue though for added moisture which is wonderful. My only true complaint with this product is that it doesn't come in a bigger bottle, since I expect I'll be going through this product very fast.
